content_sections.heading: ECR GDCE Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notification includes 1,465 vacancies under 24 post categories. The post-wise vacancy distribution is provided below.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply?
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a regular employee of East Central Railway or Rail Wheel Plant, Bela. There is no minimum service requirement. Employees who have resigned or transferred from East Central Railway are not eligible. RPF and RPSF personnel cannot apply under this GDCE notification. Employees cannot apply for the same post on which they are presently working. The applicant must possess the required qualification by 15 October 2026. The qualification must be recorded in the employee’s service register.

content_sections.heading: Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: The 50% marks requirement for Commercial Cum Ticket Clerk will not apply to SC, ST, Persons with Benchmark Disabilities, ex-servicemen and candidates possessing a qualification higher than Class 12. Candidates should check the post-wise trade, engineering discipline and medical-standard requirements in Annexure A of the official notification.

rows.required_qualification: Matriculation or SSLC with ITI or completed Act Apprenticeship in a prescribed trade; alternatively, a Diploma or Degree in the specified engineering disciplines

Degree from a recognized university or equivalent
Degree from a recognized university or equivalent

Graduate degree from a recognized university or equivalent

content_sections.heading: ECR GDCE Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit will be calculated as of 1 January 2027 . Reserved-category candidates applying against unreserved vacancies will not receive category-based age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The exact selection stages depend on the post selected by the candidate. Single-stage Computer Based Test Computer Based Aptitude Test, where applicable Computer Based Typing Skill Test, where applicable Document verification Medical examination There will be a negative marking of one-third mark for each incorrect answer in the CBT. Marks may be normalized when the examination is conducted in multiple shifts.

rows.additional_selection_test: CBT followed by document verification and medical examination, as applicable

content_sections.heading: Minimum Qualifying Marks
content_sections.text: For the aptitude test, candidates must obtain a minimum T-score of 42 in each test battery. No category-based relaxation is allowed in this requirement.

content_sections.heading: Senior Clerk Typing Test
content_sections.text: Candidates appearing for the Senior Clerk post must achieve either of the following typing speeds on a computer: 30 words per minute in English; or 25 words per minute in Hindi. The typing test is qualifying in nature. Its marks will not be added while preparing the merit list.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The official GDCE notification does not specify an application fee.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ECR GDCE Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the East Central Railway official website . Open the Hajipur Headquarters section. Select RRC Patna and open the GDCE section. Click the application link for notification number RRC/ECR/HRD/Rectt/GDCE/2026. Select the New Registration option. Enter the 11-digit employee ID and date of birth. Provide the required personal, service, educational and contact details. Log in using the registration number and password received through email or SMS. Upload the required photograph, signature and supporting certificates. Select eligible posts and enter the post preferences carefully. Review and submit the online application. Save the submitted application as a PDF or take a printout for future reference. Only one online application should be submitted. Candidates do not need to send an application printout or copies of certificates to RRC/ECR by post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under ECR GDCE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 1,465 vacancies have been announced under 24 post categories.

faq.question: Q2. Can candidates from outside East Central Railway apply?
faq.answer: No. This is a departmental examination for eligible regular employees of East Central Railway and Rail Wheel Plant, Bela.

faq.question: Q3. Can RPF or RPSF employees apply?
faq.answer: No. RPF and RPSF personnel are not eligible under this GDCE notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 15 October 2026, up to 23:59 hours.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 42 years for UR, 45 years for OBC and 47 years for SC/ST candidates as of 1 January 2027.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Computer Based Test followed by an aptitude test or typing test where applicable, document verification and medical examination.

faq.question: Q7. Is there negative marking in the CBT?
faq.answer: Yes. One-third mark will be deducted for each incorrect answer.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes. Eligible employees may select more than one post category through a single online application.
